headline: Hyperscalers charge double or more than neoclouds across every GPU; MI300X leads price-performance.
bullets: H100 SXM shows the widest hyperscaler premium at +217%, with a hyperscaler median of $12.12 versus $3.82 at neoclouds and a cheapest provider median of $2.27 at Vast.ai.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $1.83 per PFLOP-hour, with a market index of $2.39 and RunPod Community Cloud listing a median of $0.50.
B200 carries the highest market index at $6.84, with a hyperscaler median of $14.24 against a neocloud median of $6.81, a +109% premium.
H200 indexes at $5.06 with a +136% hyperscaler premium, and its $5.12 per PFLOP-hour is costlier than B200 at $3.04.
A100 80GB SXM has the narrowest hyperscaler premium at +100%, but at $7.02 per PFLOP-hour it is the least efficient GPU tracked.
watch: With only 4 days of history, watch whether the 7-day trend window fills in to show if the +217% H100 SXM hyperscaler premium holds.
